mapper.select: /* selectBuyerMdAmPrivateInfoAlterApproved */ SELECT A.APPR_ID, A.APPR_NAME, A.APPR_SEQ, A.GUBUN FROM ICOMAPSE A, ICOMAPPT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.APP_PATH = B.APP_PATH AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.GUBUN = 'C' AND NVL(B.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.APPR_SEQ

/* selectBuyerMdAmPrivateInfoAlterRefer */ SELECT A.APPR_ID, A.APPR_NAME, A.APPR_SEQ, A.GUBUN FROM ICOMAPSE A, ICOMAPPT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.APP_PATH = B.APP_PATH AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.GUBUN = 'R' AND NVL(B.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.APPR_SEQ

/* selectDefaultApprovalLineMembers — 기본 결재경로(DEFAULT_FLAG='Y') 의 결재(C)/참조(R)/합의(H) 멤버 통합 조회 */ SELECT A.APPR_ID, A.APPR_NAME, A.APPR_SEQ, A.GUBUN FROM ICOMAPSE A, ICOMAPPT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.APP_PATH = B.APP_PATH AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.GUBUN IN ('C','R','H') AND NVL(B.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.GUBUN, A.APPR_SEQ
